csv_project_name: AE for MCC General Bldg Renovations Repair & Upgrades
csv_scope_of_work: Massasoit Community College is seeking to procure House Doctor services for building system upgrades, interior and exterior renovations, architectural upgrades, roofing projects, accessibility projects and utilities, roadways and parking upgrades. House Doctors will be required to provide technical advice, creative problem solving, building code reviews, construction administration, and project oversight. Services may include, but are not limited to, feasibility and certified studies for small capital projects with an estimated construction cost up to $5M. In addition, House Doctor services may also include a variety of deferred maintenance projects on campus. The scope of work may include but is not limited to: 1. Investigating the nature and severity of the problem that must be addressed under the task order. 2. Fully documenting existing conditions, including external factors that may not be addressed under the task order. 3. Developing a detailed scope of work and related cost information for the proposed project that references energy costs, sustainability principles, expected remaining useful life of building systems and related life cycle costs in conformance with the requirements of Executive Order 594. 4. Proposing an alternative strategy for the resolution of the problem in conformance with the requirements outlined in #3 above. 5. Developing the preferred solution through schematic design and/or design development. 6. Preparing construction specifications and documents, cost estimates, and providing construction administration services.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Cost Estimating, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
